kurz: Swirl cold butter into a hot but not boiling reduction. The sauce turns glossy, silky and round.
bild_im_kopf: Like snow melting slowly in your hand instead of on a hot stove: only that way does it keep its form.
was_passiert: [[butter|Butter]] itself is already an [[emulsion|emulsion]] of fat, water and milk protein. If it melts slowly in a warm liquid, the fat droplets stay finely spread and make the sauce silky. If the sauce boils afterwards, the fat separates again.
typische_fehler: Butter into boiling sauce: it melts into pools of fat instead of thickening.
schritte: Take the sauce or reduction off the heat.
Swirl or stir in cold butter cubes one at a time.
Add more butter only when the previous piece has almost melted.
Do not let it boil again; keep warm and serve soon.
